verdict.rationale: Fathom's pricing page lists "search across calls" alongside clips and playlists, plus a conversational meeting assistant, keyword alerts and topic monitoring. That is a first-party cross-meeting search capability, but each is only a one-line marketing mention. The API's meeting filters (company domain, meeting type, team) are metadata filters, not full-text search. missing for 10: documented scope of search across transcripts, summaries and notes, any evidence of jumping to the exact timestamp where something was said, in-depth search docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
